name: Both teams' formation labels render as visible text on the match page
description: When a visitor opens the Lineups panel on a match page, a prominent formation label is rendered for the home team and a separate formation label is rendered for the away team, each as visible text matching a valid formation pattern.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the lineups region
Verify a formation label matching a digits-and-hyphens pattern such as 4-3-3 is visible within the home team column
Verify a separate formation label matching a digits-and-hyphens pattern is visible within the away team column
